verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a reasonable thing for a financial platform's web app to offer, so this axis applies. The pack documents AgentOS (MCP server, CLI, skills, plugins) and the developer connectors, but these let external agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex act on the account. None of the evidence describes an AI assistant built into the Airwallex web app or product itself that users can delegate tasks to.
